propositions: Extract create recovery logic into binding_recovery.py module while preserving existing facade signature and invocation site behavior in run_differs.py.
Implement classifier to detect interrupted-retirement state only when tombstone, live forward entry, and live reverse entry share exact local id and Jira key match.
Complete interrupted retirement by removing redundant live forward/reverse pair while retaining tombstone; idempotent and aborts safely on identity mismatch or corruption.
Keyed pending recovery performs no search; keyless pending recovery enforces both three-miss threshold and 3600-second grace period without early stopping on single entry failure.
All existing create-recovery test suites must pass unmodified; retirement completion testing adds direct-module tier with identity-mismatch and replacement-failure fixtures.
